title: Raabitah: Connect Your Heart
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor ya RijaalAllah. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah,
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! O our Lord, we are praying and asking forgiveness. We are
praying and asking Your blessings. O our Lord, grant us for the honor of the most honored one through Your
Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Allah zidhu `izzan wa sharafan wa nooran wa surooran, give him
more and more and more, endlessly more. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam ya Rasoolullah, ya HabeebAllah. Ya
Sultan al-Awliya, ashfa` lana, we are asking your intercession that we can save ourselves here and Hereafter.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As-salaamu `alaykum ya `ibaadullah! Also I am saying to the master of our planet, Qutb az-Zamaan, the pole
of this planet, and sending our humble respects to him and asking humbly support from his side to a weak
servant for the Lord of Heavens, the Lord of Creation, the Lord of whole creatures! Then as-salaamu
`alaykum our listeners! Who is coming from heart, entering to heart. Who is coming from our tongues,
reaching to tongues and disappearing. Therefore, you must ask humbly that you should be granted by the
Seal of Prophets (s) an understanding. If you are not asking understanding then we have been left to our very
weak creation. What we can hear and what we can keep through our minds is according to be a servant

imprisoned in himself. That is going to be like a battery: the power that going to be through that instrument,
when battery finishing that instrument dying.
Therefore, we are in need to reach a connection through one of heavenly masters, not to leave our batteries to
finish. Their names are in holy books and in Holy Qur'an they are waasileen, means whom they reached real
source that is never ending, they are not using that time battery, no. Who reached to heavenly power station
and from that stations a line to their hearts, is waasileen, connected people. Now billions of people are living
on this planet, but perhaps you can find some handful people that they should be waasileen, who are reaching
heavenly power stations.
Therefore, we are in need... Huuu... to reach one station, one power station through heavenly levels. Dastoor
ya RijaalAllah! And power of a person who reaching first level, that weakest position when getting second
level, getting more powerful, third more powerful, fourth, fifth, sixth, and (at) seventh, full power reaching
those people whom they have reached heavenly power stations and they are not in need to use batteries,
finished!
O Mankind! If you are asking for reaching heavenly connection, you must ask, "Who can take my hand and
taking me to that authorized one and making a connection finished?" Weakest one that he has a connection,
if whole learned people bringing their knowledge besides his heavenly knowledge, going to be like a spot
through an ocean, yes. That is a beginning for tonight’s association. Therefore, it is forbidden who are
authorized to address people not to look from books, taking, no! But they have been granted a heavenly
attribute that with that he may reach one of heavenly ones. And we are in need of such a knowledge now,
because what people they are knowing now, they can't reach with this knowledge to reach first level of
heavens. They must reach waasileen, whom they reached first level of heavens; that is raabitah, connection
from heart to hearts. So many ignorant people are denying reality of raabitah! They are under zero, ignorant
ones. Not after zero, under zero! No levels for who are denying raabitah.
Raabitah proving who reaching that connection, teaching or giving them a reality, that through raabitah you
may reach heavenly levels. You can't reach by Concorde planes and you can't reach by rockets, no. Rockets
going up but can’t reach a connection with anything and coming back. Connection only going to be through
same-quality ones. Man making a raabitah connection with heavenly beings because we have spirituality and

we have souls. That souls belongs to the heavens; you can't touch it (because) no mass for them reaching.
Therefore, people whom they are using raabitah, asking a connection through their souls and through
heavenly beings, they reached and raabitah is okay. But so many ignorant ones they are trying to deny. When
you are denying raabitah you are denying prophecy, because every prophet must reach to angel of wahiyy,
revelation. Without that raabitah, that connection that you can't touch it and you can’t see it, it is impossible
to be on Earth a holy one! Whole holy ones must have a connection to heavenly beings, but it is not through
their physical being, no. If you are asking to reach somewhere with your physical being by asking a raabitah
from here up to moon, for example, you can't do that, you may going to be like ashes, physical being burning.
If it is not burning, you can't reach that raabitah connection, because our physical beings are material beings
from elements of this planet, and they are not in need such a being or its connection, its raabita to heavenly
beings.
Raabitah from both sides must be on same quality. Man can’t be in raabitah with an angel because Man's
manifestation is something, and angels' creation another kind. But Man has been granted from heavens such
a power. That it is our souls, never belonging to material beings. That may connect our souls, may connect to
an angel, but never our physical being going to be in connection. Even prophets, even the Seal of Prophet (s),
when revelation coming, he was leaving his physical being and his original heavenly being was coming in
raabitah, or can't carry (the revelation). This body can't carry, it will be burnt.
Therefore in Islam, raabitah is one of the most important realities and also most difficult for understanding.
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• •••••••••••• •••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••••
Ya ayyuha 'lladheena aamanoo asbiroo wa saabiroo wa raabitoo w 'ataqullaha la`alakum tuflihoon. O ye who
believe! Persevere in patience and constancy; vie in such perseverance; strengthen each other; and fear Allah.
that ye may prosper. (Surat Aali-`Imraan, 3:200)
That is a holy command for raabitah. How they are denying raabitah? Holy Qur'an saying to use raabitah.
Now we are sitting together and we are not in need a raabita when we are sitting face-to-face, but when you
are absent how you can reach? To an absent being how our physical being going to reach that one? Can’t
carry. We must then use our spirit being that belongs to heavens, that raabita. That is an important point that
thousands of `ulama are not reaching to give an understanding or definition on it.

Therefore, as-salaamu `alaykum listeners! Don’t listen to me, I know nothing, but spirituality that it is a
grant from heavens just trained through seclusions. Through seclusions may do our physical being to leave
that power that it belongs to heavens and standing there like a rock, and our heavenly being just reaching
there, that reaching. I saw yesterday a newspaper. It is their imagination, they said that one biggest telescope
are reaching to some stars that distance from here or from our galaxy to that high stars and galaxies how long
distance. I am surprising they are saying 15 billion light years, tawba astagfirullah! You understand it taking
only eight minutes, seven minutes and light they are saying from sun up to here that distance that they are
speaking on it 15 billion light years. Oh, oh. Either those people must be something wrong through their
heads, or what is that? How they are reaching? They are cheating people.
If a person has a wisdom, through himself he may understand that huge distances are possible; we are not
saying impossible, but possible. I am only objecting on that one's report and saying they are not knowing
behind Sun that its lights coming here in seven minutes. They are unable to know behind sun what
happening and it is so close to our Earth, only five or six minutes. How you are saying 15 billion light years
distance? You are saying something, doesn’t matter. That showing `azhaamat il-khaaliq - the greatness of the
Creator, because if they are reporting 15 billion light years, beyond that may be not billion, but trillion years'
distance. If reaching there, you can reach another distance from that may be 1000 quadrillion light years!
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar for reaching, but they are on wrong way, making that research not true, because
our physical being never making a raabitah to stars. Only your soul that belong to heavens, through that you
can reach such a distances and you are not in need 15 billion or 100 trillion or 1000 quadrillion light years,
no! It is only ship shack. That raabitah that our learned people never understanding is something else,
because their knowledge only through lines of books, and they can't get out from that lines. How they can
reach through their mindly powers to such a distance? It is impossible, but our souls that belong to heavens
in an eye-blink may be such a distance, passing through more and more!
O People! Try to understand something. What saying newspapers? Giving such a news that our minds can't
carry, but our souls saying, "Yes, why not?" Because they haven’t any connection, heavenly connection
nothing; they are always choosing material beings and its possibilities, and nothing else. But reality of
raabitah most important thing through religions, and now our ignorant doctors or ignorant learned people

are saying, "No raabitah, no raabitah." How you are living on Earth and Allah saying. They are understanding
Arabic? If not understanding, looking (to) their translations a little bit can give understanding.
Allah Allah. I am sorry to disturb you, but what we can do? Allah Allah, Subhan Allah. Allah Allah, Sultan
Allah. If no raabitah connection from Earth to heavens, you are nothing, nothing knowing, nothing seeing,
nothing hearing, and nothing understanding! La hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyi 'l-`Azheem. Allah
Allah, Sultan Allah. `Azhamatu Rabbuna Jalla Jalaaluhu!
What we are saying is only one little spot from endless Power Oceans, qudratu ilaahi, Power Oceans for the
Lord of Heavens. Don't use your mind, use your souls to be mu'min! By reading books you can't reach
anything! Books only showing you how you can reach a raabitah, a connection through your heavenly being
and if heavenly being not coming with your physical being, you are understanding nothing. Allahu akbar.
Ya Rabbee! You know we know nothing and we may say You are happy!
Dome dome dome dome
O People! O our listeners! Shanlik, (shining) in a dark night countless stars giving their lights and people
coming and looking, and they are changing from being asking to reach to their real being. To reach that, such
a things that we are saying, no, it is so beautiful! If an opening coming, our minds a little bit only for
understanding around ourselves, but our soul's limits every time going to be more and more shanlik
(shining). Sometimes like Christians are doing New Year's night fireworks and people making like this. When
reaching with your soul beyond material being, oh, oh, so, so beautiful! Because you are running into Beauty
Oceans! You can't imagine! That is barakah of raabitah! Don’t object on raabitah; it is the most important key
for opening the secret treasures of heavens. Those people who are asking to reach something through space,
we are asking dominions of oceans. What is space? Space is nothing! This whole our space, our universe
going to be like a spot!
O People! Come and listen. Come and think on it. May Allah forgive us, and grant us a real faith for
understanding.
Dome dome dome 4x

Fatihah.
They know to close it. Shukran. (335,000 viewers) As He likes; doesn’t matter. Even one hearing, doesn’t
matter, it is good.
("Jewels Oceans," says Shaykh Adnan, praising the talk.)
I am speaking as a translator, as they make me to speak.
("This is the first opening on raabitah," says Shaykh Adnan.)
Without raabitah a man dies. Thank you! They like it? Salaam to Shaykh Hisham.
